name: Koi Pond — Hand-Painted Art Deck
tagline: Two koi circling through a midnight lily pond.
description: A pair of golden koi glide through deep indigo water, framed by lily pads and blossoming lotus. In many cultures koi symbolise good fortune, perseverance and harmony, which makes this piece a meaningful gift as well as a statement for your wall. Every scale, fin and ripple is painted by hand in layered acrylics, then sealed with a protective varnish so the colours stay rich for years.
details: Hand-painted acrylic on a real wooden skateboard deck

name: Hibiscus & Bone — Hand-Painted Art Deck
tagline: Soft blooms meet bold street art on forest green.
description: A sculpted white skull crowned with crimson hibiscus flowers, wrapped in sweeping black vines on a deep forest-green deck. It sits between street art and botanical illustration: edgy, but beautiful. Made for bedrooms, studios, cafés and anyone who likes their décor with a little attitude.
details: Hand-painted acrylic on a real wooden skateboard deck

name: Lavender Fields Hurricane Lantern
tagline: A classic hurricane lantern, reborn in lavender.
description: A vintage-style metal hurricane lantern finished in soft white and hand-painted with sprigs of lavender, tiny violet blossoms and a single purple butterfly. Hang it on a balcony, set it on a bedside table or use it as a centrepiece. It brings a gentle, cottage-garden glow to any corner.
details: Works with a battery LED candle (recommended indoors)

name: Vintage Bloom Candle Lantern
tagline: Gold leaf, painted florals and a flickering glow.
description: A matte-black vintage lamp with a tall glass chimney, hand-painted with folk-style blooms in rust and lime and finished with a collar of real gold leaf. The included flameless LED candle flickers like the real thing, so it's safe for bedrooms, shelves and gift tables.

name: Crimson Silhouette Art Tray
tagline: Abstract art you can hang or serve on.
description: A single sweeping stroke of crimson rises from a deep black field and forms an abstract figure caught mid-movement. It's a signed original artwork that doubles as a framed wooden tray: display it upright on a console or hang it as wall art.

name: Afternoon Tea Serving Tray
tagline: Teapots, books and wildflowers on a summer-sky blue.
description: A whimsical illustrated tray full of the small joys of tea time: patterned teapots, steaming cups, stacks of books, wildflowers and tiny mushrooms, all painted by hand on bright sky blue inside a deep-green shimmer frame. Perfect for chai at home, a café counter, or a gift for the tea-lover who has everything.
details: Ideal as a serving or display tray

name: Blush Bloom Serving Tray
tagline: Matisse-inspired botanicals in pink, sage and sunshine.
description: Oversized cut-out style blooms in blush pink and buttery yellow, with sage-green leaves on a warm pink ground, all framed in bold red. It's joyful and modern, and looks just as good on a vanity as it does serving dessert.

name: Noir Gilded Planter
tagline: Porcelain white, dipped in black and real gold leaf.
description: A minimalist white planter with a hand-dipped black base and a band of real gold leaf where the two meet. Each one is a little different. It's luxurious and understated, perfect for a succulent, a small orchid or as a jewellery catch-all.
details: Arrives in a JAHM gift box

name: Lavender Honey Planter
description: A textured hobnail pot in warm honey yellow, hand-painted with stems of lavender and finished with a cotton twine bow and a wooden tag. It's cheerful and gift-ready, a little piece of a Provence summer for your windowsill.
details: Arrives in a JAHM gift box

name: Cerulean Cherry Planter
tagline: Glossy painted cherries on a sky-blue pot.
description: Plump, glossy red cherries scattered across a soft cerulean pot. It's sweet, playful and retro: a gift that makes people smile. Use it for a small plant, pens on your desk or makeup brushes.
details: Arrives in a JAHM gift box
